answer.rationale: memory_57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. memory_44 links sales-assisted enterprise conversion to pipeline quality, though realized revenue and durability are omitted. memory_31 reports a durable activation lift, but not downstream revenue quality. memory_73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits retention, margins, discount dependency, and long-term customer quality. memory_86 improves onboarding and adoption but provides no revenue or durability evidence. memory_91 only demonstrates short-term engagement and first-action gains, with no evidence of qualified revenue, retention, or lasting impact.
